## The sandbox

Your sandbox is a normal workspace with the limits removed. It is where you build client coworkers and where [templates are captured from](/templates/create): capturing is restricted to the sandbox on purpose, so a client workspace can never be published by accident.

One difference from a client workspace: a sandbox keeps its in-app notifications but never sends notification emails, so a test cron failing overnight stays out of your inbox.

## Your profile

The directory profile carries your bio, your skills, the languages you work in, your budget range and your links. Clients filter on all of it.

Write the bio in markdown. It is the part clients actually read, so lead with what you have shipped rather than what you offer.

## Selling templates

Publishing rights come with the program. See [Create a template](/templates/create) for the workflow and [Sell a template](/templates/selling) for pricing and payouts.

## Applying

Applications are reviewed by the Lumvika team. What helps: coworkers you have actually shipped, a clear specialty, and a profile that a client can act on.

Start at [lumvika.com/community/experts/program](https://lumvika.com/community/experts/program).
